Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella pneumoniae, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and low specific gravity are noted. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy based on sensitivity testing.
